metadata.title: Marvell Stock Soars as Chip Company Issues Warrant to Google to Buy Stake of $12.2 Billion<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Marvell Stock Soars as Chip Company Issues Warrant to Google to Buy Stake of $12.2 Billion
Shares of Marvell Technology surged Wednesday after the company announced it has issued Alphabet-owned Google a warrant to purchase up to 59 million shares, or take a $12.2 billion stake in the chip maker.
